milestones.claim: Versioned full Task Context and content-addressed Prompt Envelope contracts exist and select full only.
milestones.doneMeans: A deterministic dispatch-kind envelope can be recomputed from canonical authoritative facts; story-dispatch forbids reviewer authority, review-run requires it, and tampering or incremental requests fail closed.

milestones.claim: Story-aware full Prompt assembly is owned by the trusted agent_prompt CLI path.
milestones.doneMeans: The CLI prints the canonical full Prompt and audit envelope for a Story, rejects caller-spliced authority fields, cannot mint reviewer evidence, and leaves role-only output byte-identical.

milestones.claim: ReviewRun, reviewer pass and lifecycle gates consume one fresh signed envelope binding without revoking still-fresh non-latest runs by recency alone.
milestones.doneMeans: Fresh evidence passes; true HEAD, material, scope or round drift and cross-run field substitution are rejected with stable reasons; material/scope-fresh non-latest passes remain admissible; retry preserves ledgerCallId and creates a fresh attemptId.

milestones.claim: Role eligibility and legacy-full-context rollback are total and gate-safe.
milestones.doneMeans: Compatibility or retired evidence cannot satisfy REVIEW, assurance floor or quorum, and a per-role rollback restores exact legacy full Prompt bytes without loosening gates.
